test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

She carried a **compact **mirror in her bag.

options.text: The nations signed a compact to strengthen unity.
He compacted the sand before laying tiles.
The suitcase was compact enough for travel.
The castle had a compact courtyard.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"compact"** used in the sentence is a homonym. A homonym is a word that has the same spelling and pronunciation but different meanings. In this context, "compact" refers to a small and convenient item, such as a mirror, which is easy to carry. (छोटा और सुविधाजनक)

 
 
• **Example:** She carried a compact mirror in her bag for quick touch-ups.
 
 
 
• In Option 1, the word **"compact"** is used as an agreement or contract between nations or parties. (समझौता)
 
 
• **Example:** The nations signed a compact to ensure peaceful coexistence.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "compact" in Option 1 is a homonym of the word "compact" used in the question.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** He compacted the sand before laying tiles. (दबाना): Here, "compacted" refers to pressing or squeezing something to make it dense or solid.

 
 
• **Example:** The workers compacted the soil to create a solid foundation for the building.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The suitcase was compact enough for travel. (छोटा और सुविधाजनक): Here, "compact" refers to something small and easy to carry, similar to the meaning used in the question, but it does not serve as a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** The compact suitcase fit easily into the overhead compartment.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The castle had a compact courtyard. (संकुचित): Here, "compact" refers to something that is small or confined in size.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite its size, the compact courtyard was beautifully designed with flowers and fountains.
